press_references.value: Asimov Forms Partnership with Kaigene to Develop Advanced Antibody Therapies

partnership_announcements.description: Asimov announced a partnership with Kaigene to develop a multispecific antibody candidate, using Asimov’s AI-driven CHO Edge System for cell-line development and research cell-bank production.

press_references.value: Asimov Announces Strategic Partnership with the Rosalind & Morris Goodman Cancer Institute at McGill University to Advance Next-Generation Biologics

partnership_announcements.description: Asimov entered a strategic partnership with the Rosalind & Morris Goodman Cancer Institute at McGill University to provide AI-powered cell line and process development services supporting next-generation biologic candidates from McGill’s oncology research programs.

press_references.value: Asimov Completes Lead Optimization Campaign with Mabylon AG to Advance Trispecific Antibody for Tree Pollen Allergies

partnership_announcements.description: Asimov and Mabylon AG completed a lead optimization campaign and partnered to evaluate Mabylon’s multispecific antibody candidates using Asimov’s Rapid Pools and CHO Edge platforms, selecting a trispecific antibody clone for clinical progression in tree pollen allergies.

press_references.value: Asimov and AGC Biologics Team Up to Provide a Cost-Effective, Simplified, and Secure Manufacturing Approach for Viral Vector Production

partnership_announcements.description: Asimov and AGC Biologics entered a licensing-based partnership allowing AGC Biologics’ Milan Cell and Gene Center of Excellence to offer Asimov’s LV Edge Packaging lentiviral production system to its customers.

press_references.value: Asimov Launches Chrysalis Transposase, a Wholly-Owned Genome Integration Tool for Biotherapeutics Production

product_launches.description: Asimov launched Chrysalis transposase, a proprietary, wholly owned genome integration tool for biotherapeutics production that can be licensed standalone, accessed within Asimov’s technology suite, or used in its cell line development services.

press_references.value: Asimov Launches Stable AAV Producer Cell Lines for Viral Vector Manufacturing

product_launches.description: Asimov launched its AAV Edge Stable Producer system, offering clonal HEK293-based AAV producer cell lines that integrate essential viral genes to reduce costs, improve batch consistency, and enable scalable bioreactor manufacturing with titers up to 6E15 vg/L.

press_references.value: AAV Manufacturing Service Market to Surge USD 6.25 Bn by 2035, Rising at a 15.84% CAGR

product_launches.description: Asimov introduced AAV Edge in October 2025, a stable producer system aimed at addressing scalability and cost challenges in AAV gene therapy manufacturing.

overview_description.description:
Asimov creates tools for programming living cells. Its multidisciplinary team is advancing the design and manufacture of biologics and gene therapies by integrating mammalian synthetic biology, computer-aided design, and machine learning.

Asimov was established in 2017 by Raja Srinivas in Boston, Massachusetts.

about_short_description.short_description: Asimov employs artificial intelligence to develop tools for the design and manufacture of next-generation therapeutics.

product.name: CHO Edge System
product.description: A CHO-based biologics expression system combining engineered host cells, genetic parts, AI-assisted vector design, and cell-line development to produce therapeutic proteins at high titers.

product.name: AAV Edge System
product.description: A modular platform for AAV gene-therapy payload design and production, combining computational design tools, genetic parts, HEK293 host cells, plasmid systems, and stable or transient manufacturing workflows.

product.name: Kernel
product.description: Cloud-based computer-aided design software for designing, simulating, analyzing, and optimizing genetic systems, expression vectors, and therapeutic payloads.

product.name: RNA Edge System
product.description: A lab-in-the-loop platform that uses AI-guided sequence design, genetic parts, RNA production, and cell-based screening to optimize linear or circular RNA therapeutic candidates.

product.name: LV Edge System
product.description: A lentiviral-vector production platform using engineered stable cell lines, packaging genetic tools, and software-assisted design to improve lentiviral titers and manufacturing consistency.

identifier.value: Cell Line Development and Process Development Services

product.name: Cell Line Development and Process Development Services
product.description: Contract development services for designing, generating, screening, and characterizing stable producer cell lines and transferring optimized processes for biologics and viral-vector programs.
